metadata.name: Malaysian SST Compliance Rules for Private Healthcare
metadata.source: Royal Malaysian Customs Department Service Tax Policy No. 5/2025 Amendment No. 2 (23 October 2025)
metadata.description: Rules for checking Sales and Service Tax (SST) compliance on Malaysian private hospital bills effective 1 July 2025.
IMPORTANT_READ_FIRST: A 6% SST applies to private healthcare facilities with total taxable revenue exceeding RM1.5 million.
Specific categories (e.g. professional doctor consultations) are EXEMPT from SST.
For the exemption to apply, the consultation fee must be separated from other charges in the same invoice.

exempt_categories.reason_for_exemption: Consultation fees charged by professional doctors at registered private healthcare facilities are explicitly exempt.
exempt_categories.source: Service Tax Policy No. 5/2025 Amendment No. 2

exempt_categories.reason_for_exemption: Services provided by registered traditional and complementary medicine practitioners are exempt.
exempt_categories.source: Service Tax Policy No. 5/2025 Amendment No. 2

exempt_categories.reason_for_exemption: Services provided by registered allied health professionals (e.g., physiotherapists, dietitians) are exempt.
exempt_categories.source: Service Tax Policy No. 5/2025 Amendment No. 2

taxable_categories.description: General facility usage charges in the private hospital.
Daily room and board charges for inpatient stays.
Charges for the use of medical equipment (e.g., MRI, CT scan machines).
Administrative, food & beverage, and other non-medical services provided by the hospital.

flag_rules.description: SST charged on an exempt category item.
flag_rules.condition: A 6% SST is applied to a line item that falls under 'Doctor Consultation Fees' or other exempt categories.
flag_rules.flag_message: SST Compliance Violation: SST is being charged on a doctor's professional consultation fee. These fees are explicitly exempt from SST under STP 5/2025.

flag_rules.condition: The calculated tax rate on a taxable item exceeds the gazetted 6% rate.
flag_rules.flag_message: SST Compliance Violation: The tax rate applied exceeds the legally gazetted 6% Service Tax rate.

flag_rules.description: SST appearing on a bill from a facility below the revenue threshold.
flag_rules.condition: SST is charged by a small standalone clinic that is unlikely to meet the RM1.5 million annual revenue threshold.
flag_rules.flag_message: Potential SST Violation: Facility is charging SST but may not meet the RM1.5M revenue threshold to be a registered SST entity. Verify facility SST registration number.

flag_rules.description: Consultation fee is not separated from taxable charges on the invoice.
flag_rules.condition: A single bundled line item includes both a doctor's consultation fee and a taxable hospital service, with SST applied to the total.
flag_rules.flag_message: SST Compliance Warning: To qualify for the consultation fee SST exemption, the consultation fee must be billed as a separate line item from other taxable charges.
